warnings: SUPPLIER COST REFERENCE ONLY - NOT RETAIL PRICING - NOT APPROVED FOR IMPORT. These are TCL supplier pro-forma purchase/discount sheets, not TAJ FROID retail price lists.
No VAT-rate field exists in either workbook. Both contain the note '*les prix (TTC) incluent la TVA' (prices include VAT). No VAT was added, removed or inferred.
No approval/signature date is filled in: 'Date:' cells are empty (TARIF A62/F62; TARIF (2) A32/F32; Order A35/G35). The pro-forma is not shown as signed by the buyer.
Discount fields are stored as fractions under header 'Remise%'. Raw fractions were recorded verbatim; no discount was applied, merged or converted.
Amount and total cells contain uncalculated spreadsheet formulas (with a few hardcoded amount values). Raw formulas/values were recorded verbatim and never evaluated; no retail price was derived.
Currency is not explicitly stated on any price cell. 'MAD' appears only in the bank-detail label 'RIB N°:(MAD)'; no currency was inferred.

Only 6 model codes in these workbooks match SKUs in stock_import/import_manifest.json by exact/normalized SKU matching. All other mentioned models are listed under explicit_non_matches; no fuzzy matching to a different product was performed.
Client differs by sheet: TV 'TARIF' says 'Client：SKY LINE ELECTRO'; TV 'TARIF (2)' says 'Client：TAJ FROID'; AC 'Order' says 'CLIENT: TAJ FROID'.
Other pro-forma/order workbooks also exist under img/TCL/. This reference covers only the two filename-identified price-list workbooks listed in source_files.
